meta.processName: Large commercial property underwriting and issuance
meta.disclosure: Illustrative. The structure comes from the source BPMN; timings, volumes and costs are assumptions.
meta.summary: Click any activity for business detail. All 5 cases scale the same representative route: clearance passes → in appetite → physical survey required → fac reinsurance required → within authority → broker binds → policy issued. Off-route branches (decline, referral-decline, submission-lost, negotiate loop) are drawn but not scheduled.

models.notes: Proposed state: AI-augmented underwriting operating model

lanes.name: AI Analytics, CAT & Pricing Agent
lanes.role: CAT ingest/metrics, layering, pricing, forms, quote

details.desc: Broker transmits submission; AI intake pipeline triggered immediately.
Agent parses submission, extracts insured entity, and performs semantic entity resolution against PAS/clearance to catch name variants, subsidiaries, BOR conflicts.
controls: Fail-closed on ambiguous match → routes to human UA
details.escalation: Ambiguous or conflicting matches → UA queue
details.note: Replaces manual clearance keyword search. UA authority retained on ambiguous cases.

details.desc: Auto-clear or escalate to UA.
Agent parses SOV workbook (any layout), normalizes columns, resolves occupancy/construction codes, geocodes locations, flags data gaps with confidence scores.
controls: Low-confidence rows routed to UA review; agent does not overwrite silently
details.note: Replaces ~4–8 hrs of manual scrub. Preserves UA authority for low-confidence rows.

details.desc: Runs appetite rules deterministically; LLM adds reasoning explanation and flags edge cases.
controls: Deterministic rules govern the decision; the LLM only explains it

details.desc: Same gate as Before.
Routes to UW by geography/industry/TIV band with load balancing.
UW reviews an AI-prepared account brief (COPE summary, loss trend chart, prior-year comparison, exposure highlights). UW makes the risk-selection judgment.
controls: UW retains risk-selection authority

details.desc: Same as Before.
AI pre-compiles COPE, protection, and prior-loss context; risk engineer reviews and decides on survey requirement.
Engineer's decision, unchanged in the future state.

nodes.label: Physical Site Survey (Retained)
nodes.sub: Physical work that cannot be automated

details.desc: Physical inspection still required. Modest improvement modeled from AI-driven scheduling coordination and pre-populated survey checklist.
assumptions: AI concierge accelerates insured scheduling by ~1 day
details.note: PHYSICAL DEPENDENCY RETAINED. Not eliminated by AI.

details.desc: AI drafts PML/MFL narrative and recs schedule from survey notes; engineer reviews, edits, and signs.
controls: Engineer sign-off required; AI output is a draft only

details.desc: Automated ingest of normalized SOV into CAT platform with API-based occupancy/construction code mapping.
Executes model runs and produces AAL, PML curves, and portfolio impact memo; run queue and compute time remain.
details.note: Compute time retained; interpretation drafted by AI, reviewed by UW downstream.

details.desc: Join waits on max(RE=2705, CAT=815) → 2705.
Agent proposes candidate layer structures with rationale; UW selects and adjusts.
controls: UW retains layering/participation authority

details.desc: Deterministic rating engine computes rate; agent recommends schedule credits/debits with cited rationale; UW approves.
controls: Rating engine is authoritative for base rate
UW authority on credits/debits

details.desc: Agent selects appropriate ISO forms and drafts manuscript endorsements from prior precedents; UW reviews and edits.
controls: Manuscript language changes require UW approval

details.desc: Same gate as Before.
Agent auto-composes fac slip: exposure summary, PML, CAT metrics, layer, sought terms.
details.note: Slip is a draft; ceded team owns market placement.

details.desc: External reinsurance market response time is a persistent dependency. Modest improvement from better-structured slip and faster follow-ups.
assumptions: AI-drafted slip reduces back-and-forth by ~1 day

details.desc: Delegated authority governance retained.
Retained human authority for out-of-authority terms. AI does not receive delegated authority.
controls: Authority sign-off remains a hard control
details.note: Off animated route in representative case.

details.desc: Off animated route.
Off animated route.
Agent compiles multi-option quote (primary, excess, quota share) with narrative rationale and subjectivities list.
details.note: Draft delivered to UW for issuance.

details.desc: UW reviews AI-assembled quote and transmits to broker.
controls: The underwriter signs the quote, not the agent

details.desc: Includes broker/insured decision wait (~3 business days, illustrative; a cleaner quote is assumed to reduce follow-ups).
Off animated route.
Agent reconciles bind order to issued quote and flags variances; UW authorizes the bind.
controls: Bind commitment made by human UW, not agent

details.desc: Automated OFAC/sanctions screening and subjectivities checklist; UA/compliance signs off.
controls: Sanctions compliance sign-off retained by human

details.desc: UW executes legally binding binder confirmation to broker.
controls: Legal commitment made by human UW

details.desc: Agent assembles dec sheet, schedule of forms, endorsements from binder record.
details.note: Assembly is deterministic against templates; QA still required.

details.desc: Human QA validates policy fields, ceded allocation, endorsement selection before PAS booking.
controls: 4-eyes QA retained
Fail-closed if reconciliation breaks

details.desc: After QA sign-off, agent writes premium and ceded allocation to PAS and triggers GL posting.
controls: Only executes after human QA sign-off
details.note: Consequential system write is gated by human sign-off.

details.desc: Transmits executed policy contract to broker.
Policy in force. Servicing begins.
